# Code of conduct

Moroder follows the [Contributor Covenant 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

In short: be kind and patient, assume good faith, and keep discussions about the work. Harassment, insults and personal attacks have no place here, in issues, pull requests or anywhere else the project lives.

If something goes wrong, contact the maintainer privately through GitHub (Security → Report a vulnerability works for anything sensitive). Reports are kept confidential. Comments, commits or contributions that break these rules may be removed, and repeated or serious cases lead to a ban from the project.
